newsitem.title: CANADA: Trimac sees strong drilling service demand.
newsitem.headline: Trimac sees strong drilling service demand.

text.p: Trimac Ltd said on Thursday that demand for its Canadian oil and gas drilling services was expected to be strong in 1997 but results in its trucking division were dependent on gaining more business in western Canada.
Trimac said all oil and gas drilling rigs in its fleet were committed until the spring of 1997 and reduced losses in its Argentina operation were encouraging.
However, additional steps were needed to be taken to complete the turnaround of the Argentine business, it said.
Gaining additional western Canadian transportation was viewed as necessary for improving results, Trimac said.
But U.S. fortunes have improved due in part to higher equipment use and it expected the trend to continue, it said.

Trimac, which earlier this month said it hired financial advisers to study a potential reorganization, said on Thursday it had yet to reach a decision on whether to implement any new initiatives. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
